changes_made.explanation: Removed datasets only mentioned as examples/scraped holdout datasets not used in main experimental setup. Normalized model capitalization and dataset names to consistent forms. Added ACLSumm+ as it's a constructed holdout dataset.

Normalized metric variants to base forms (e.g., ROUGE variants to ROUGE). Removed GPT-4 based evaluation metrics as those are LLM-as-judge evaluations, not automatic metrics. Added Domain Vocabulary Overlap which was mentioned in the paper.
Simplified method descriptions and normalized criteria to lowercase. Kept only the core LLM judge model and evaluation approach.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on performance prediction for text summarization under domain shift and instruct-tuning. The extraction quality was generally good, but needed normalization of metrics variants and clarification between automatic metrics vs. LLM-as-judge evaluations. The paper uses both automatic metrics and LLM/human evaluations to validate their performance prediction methodology.
